nodes.description: Total token supply state variable of StandardToken, returns totalSupply_.
Mapping address to token balance, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the airdrop credit paths.
Nested mapping owner/spender to allowance, mutated by approve, increaseApproval and decreaseApproval.
Public owner address, set by the Ownable constructor and updated by transferOwnership.
Token name constant string, HotPotChain.
Token symbol constant string, HPC.
Token decimals, used in unchecked exponentiation for the initial supply.
Total supply computed at declaration as 21000000 * 10**decimals, shadows StandardToken.totalSupply function.
Remaining airdrop pool, decremented by distribute.
Supply minus airdrop pool, credited to the deployer and never decremented afterwards.
Per-claim airdrop amount, clamped against totalRemaining.
Flag halting further airdrops once the pool is exhausted.
Mapping address to bool marking addresses that already claimed the airdrop.
Checked multiplication helper using assert on the reverse division.
Division helper relying on Solidity revert on division by zero.
Checked subtraction helper asserting b <= a.
Checked addition helper asserting c >= a.
View function returning the totalSupply_ state variable.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath arithmetic on balances.
View function returning balances[_owner].
Transfers tokens on behalf of _from using the allowed[_from][msg.sender] allowance.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] to _value and emits Approval.
View function returning the allowance of spender for owner.
Increases the caller allowance for _spender by _addedValue using SafeMath.add.
Decreases the caller allowance for _spender, zeroing it when the subtraction exceeds the current value.
Constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function transferring the ownership to newOwner after a zero address check.
Constructor computing totalRemaining and crediting the whole amount to balances[msg.sender].
Private function subtracting from totalAirDrop and crediting balances[_to]; never decrements totalRemaining.
Payable fallback function that forwards every plain call to airDropTokens.
Public payable airdrop entry point guarded by canDistribute and onlyWhitelist, blacklisting the caller.
Overriding balance view function returning balances[_owner].
Caller-controlled address used as owner, spender, investor and airdrop recipient.
Unchecked multiplication/exponentiation 21000000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals)) at state variable initialisation.
Payable fallback lets any external caller trigger the airdrop logic without authorisation.
Constructor assigns the full totalRemaining balance to the deployer address.
totalAirDrop is decremented while totalRemaining is never reduced, allowing repeated claims to exceed the intended pool.
Caller address is written into the blacklist after a single claim, the only per-address restriction.
Sender balance is debited with SafeMath.sub after a require check on the balance.
airDropTokens has no owner check, so any non-blacklisted address can drain the airdrop pool.
Cached current allowance read before the decrease branch.
Local copy of msg.sender used as the airdrop recipient and blacklist key.
Local copy of airDropNumber used as the amount handed to distribute.
Recipient address of StandardToken.transfer.
Amount transferred by StandardToken.transfer.
Account debited by StandardToken.transferFrom.
Account credited by StandardToken.transferFrom.
Allowance amount spent by StandardToken.transferFrom.
Spender granted allowance in StandardToken.approve.
Allowance value set in StandardToken.approve.
New owner address written into the owner state variable.
Airdrop recipient of HotPotToken.distribute.
Airdrop amount subtracted from totalAirDrop in HotPotToken.distribute.
Spender whose allowance is increased.
Value added to the caller allowance.
Spender whose allowance is decreased.
Value subtracted from the caller allowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender keys the sender balance read and written by transfer.
msg.sender acts as the spender in allowed[_from][msg.sender] during transferFrom.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
increaseApproval updates allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval reads and writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
Ownable constructor initialises owner from msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner.
HotPotToken constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with totalRemaining.
onlyWhitelist checks blacklist[msg.sender] and the caller becomes the investor.
Fallback caller identity is carried into the forwarded airdrop call.
msg.sender indexes the balance credited in the constructor.
msg.sender address is written into the blacklist after claiming.
Any external address can reach the airdrop entry point without owner rights.
owner state variable is populated with msg.sender.
decimals feeds the unchecked exponentiation at declaration time.
Unchecked multiplication result is assigned to totalSupply.
totalRemaining is derived from totalSupply minus totalAirDrop.
totalAirDrop is subtracted from totalSupply while computing totalRemaining.
Constructor reads totalRemaining for the deployer credit.
Unsafe assignment writes balances[msg.sender].
Unsafe credit executes inside the HotPotToken constructor.
Constructor mutates the balances mapping.
totalRemaining is computed with SafeMath.sub.
totalAirDrop is the variable reduced by the unsafe debit.
distribute performs totalAirDrop.sub(_amount).
Decremented value is written back to totalAirDrop.
distribute never decrements totalRemaining, so the accounting pool diverges.
airDropTokens writes the blacklist flag for the investor.
Unsafe write updates the blacklist mapping.
Public payable airdrop entry point lacks an owner authorisation check.
Fallback function forwards the call to airDropTokens.
Payable fallback lets any caller start the airdrop flow.
transfer reads and rewrites the balances mapping.
SafeMath.sub debits the sender balance inside transfer.
Updated balance is stored back into balances.
owner is overwritten by transferOwnership.
Ownable constructor sets the owner state variable.
canDistribute modifier reads distributionFinished.
onlyWhitelist modifier reads the blacklist mapping.
airDropNumber determines the granted amount and is clamped to totalRemaining.
Airdrop amount flows out of totalAirDrop.
airDropNumber is reduced to totalRemaining when it exceeds the remaining pool.
distributionFinished is set when the drop pool falls below airDropNumber.
airDropTokens writes blacklist[investor] = true.
airDropTokens calls the internal distribute function.
distribute credits balances[_to] with the airdrop amount.
distribute debits totalAirDrop.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub.
transfer calls SafeMath.add.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add.
increaseApproval calls SafeMath.add.
decreaseApproval calls SafeMath.sub.
distribute calls SafeMath.sub on totalAirDrop.
distribute calls SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reduces allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval writes the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval writes the allowed mapping.
_to is the checked zero-address recipient credited by transfer.
_value is subtracted from the sender balance in transfer.
_from is the debited account in transferFrom.
_to is the credited account in transferFrom.
_value is spent from the caller allowance in transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance beneficiary in approve.
_value is the allowance amount in approve.
newOwner is written into owner by transferOwnership.
_to is the airdrop recipient in distribute.
_amount is subtracted from totalAirDrop in distribute.
_spender is the allowance beneficiary in increaseApproval.
_addedValue is added to the caller allowance.
_spender is the allowance beneficiary in decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue is subtracted from the caller allowance.
oldValue caches the allowance before the decrease branch.
investor is assigned from msg.sender in airDropTokens.
toGive is assigned from airDropNumber in airDropTokens.
investor is passed as the distribute recipient.
toGive is passed as the distribute amount.
investor becomes the new blacklist entry.
newOwner replaces the owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: oldValue is a temporary cache of allowed[msg.sender][_spender] and is fully contained in decreaseApproval.
investor is just msg.sender copied inside airDropTokens and carries no independent semantics.
toGive is a copy of the airDropNumber state variable local to airDropTokens.
_to is only meaningful as the recipient argument of transfer.
_value is only meaningful as the amount argument of transfer.
_from is only meaningful as the debited account argument of transferFrom.
_to is only meaningful as the credited account argument of transferFrom.
_value is only meaningful as the allowance spend argument of transferFrom.
_spender is only meaningful as the allowance beneficiary argument of approve.
_value is only meaningful as the allowance argument of approve.
newOwner is only meaningful as the argument that becomes the owner state variable.
_to is only meaningful as the credited airdrop recipient argument of distribute.
_amount is only meaningful as the subtracted amount argument of distribute.
_spender is only meaningful as the allowance beneficiary argument of increaseApproval.
_addedValue is only meaningful as the allowance increment argument of increaseApproval.
_spender is only meaningful as the allowance beneficiary argument of decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue is only meaningful as the allowance decrement argument of decreaseApproval.
